thread:
sofia: Quick sync 
We need an onboarding checklist + demo sandbox for the 3-cloud listing. Owner? Target: Friday EOD.

raj: I can own the checklist spreadsheet. I'll break out columns for image-id, publisher-account, billing-sku, trial-toggle, private-offer flag, and ops play. Sharing shortly.

emma: Legal will need to review the trial terms (trial duration, data retention for trial accounts, export control check). If EU/UK regions are included we may need localized EULAs. Looping intl-legal if needed.

clayton: Packaging suggestion: two SKUs + optional private-offer tier. Proposed labels: "Redwood Core (Hosted)" and "Redwood Core (Dedicated)". Trial: 14d hosted with 100k token cap. We should avoid implying "free unlimited" in listing copy.

sofia: For sandbox creds: do we want tenant-scoped demo users (read-only) or full-feature sandbox? My preference: tenant-scoped with feature flags enabled for chat+embeddings. Need publisher portal access to create the offer.

lisa: Tenant-scoped is safer. Include an ops rollback plan in the spreadsheet. Also add a column for "demo-data-type" (synthetic vs sanitized).

sofia: Runbook snippet for short-lived creds (will add to 1Password):
```bash
# create scoped demo user (AWS example)
aws iam create-user --user-name rfwd-demo-tenant
aws iam attach-user-policy --user-name rfwd-demo-tenant --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
# issue keys, then immediately store in 1Password collection 'marketplace-demos'
```

security: 1Password rules: use collection name 'marketplace-demos', set TTL=5d, rotate keys after demo usage, disable console access for demo users, and audit log enabled. No long-lived keys in repo.

raj: Uploaded initial checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1marketplace_onboard_xyz 
Columns: cloud, region, image-id, service-account, demo-cred-type, trial-sku, offer-type, legal-notes, ops-runbook. Filling image ids for us-east-1, europe-west1, and eastasia.

nate-runtime: I'll add recommended instance SKUs, latency SLOs, and quantization guidance by EOD today. Will include CPU fallbacks and recommended batching settings for 1-4 token bursts.

marketing: We'll need staging endpoints + short-lived keys to produce screenshots and a 60s demo next week. Also need product blurbs and one-liner for marketplace hero.

sofia: Publisher portal invite request done. marketplace-bot: Publisher portal invite dispatched at 09:18 
Invite link: https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/pub/invite/XYZ123 (expires in 72h)

emma: Legal quick note: ensure product description avoids regulated-language ("HIPAA-ready") unless we've signed BAAs. Also check claims around data residency.

clayton: We'll add explicit copy: "Option for Dedicated deployment with region-bound data storage" for Dedicated SKU. For Hosted SKU, clarify standard retention and purge policy.

sofia: I'll provision the sandbox and post 1Password link when creds are ready. Also will add a short troubleshooting section for common publisher-portal errors (missing organization mapping, mismatched billing account).

security: Reminder: do not upload keys to Drive links. Store only pointers in Drive and actual secrets in 1Password. Enable access logs for demo accounts.

raj: FYI I added a column for "private offer required?" for enterprise customers who need entitlements. Also added a draft mapping for Azure VM image names and GCP image families.

lisa: Timeline: Raj finalize checklist by Thu EOD, Sofia share creds in 1P Fri AM, Nate add runtime notes Thu EOD, Legal sign-off Fri EOD assuming no localization required. Marketing to schedule recording next Tue.

marketing: Acknowledged. Will book a 1-hour slot Tue and a copy review with Product next Mon.

sofia: Spinning up sandbox now; will post back with 1P link.

marketplace-bot: Offer draft created: offer-id rfwd-core-2026. Link: https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/offer/rfwd-core-2026

lisa: Great work team. If there are any blockers (publisher portal invite issues, image family mismatches, or legal localization needs) post here and we'll triage. :rocket:
